content: .{@-अटः@} (खेऽटः) .²1 a planet. .²2 Rāhu, the ascending node.

खेट {%a.%} [खे अटति, अट्-अच्; खिट्-अच् वा] Having a weapon, armed. .{@-टः@} .²1 A village, small town or hamlet; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 6. 11</ls>. .²2 Phlegm. .²3 The club of Balarāma. .²4 A horse. .{@-टः, -टम्@} .²1 Hunting, chase. .²2 A shield. .{@-टम्@} .²1 Grass. .²2 Hide, skin. ({%<ab>N. B.</ab>%}:-- At the end of <ab>comp.</ab> खेट expresses ‘defectiveness’ or ‘deterioration’, & may be rendered by ‘miserable’, ‘low’, ‘vile’, ‘wretched’ <ab>&c.</ab>; नागरखेटम् a miserable town.) .²3 A village; नगराद्योजनं खेटं खेटाद् ग्रामोऽर्धयोजनम् (<ls>Brahmānaṃda pu˚ Part I, II</ls> अनुषंगपाद. Ch. 7. <ls>V. 111.</ls>); खेटानि धूलिप्राकारोपेतानि . (प्रश्नव्याकरणसूत्रव्याख्याने). .²4 A village of cultivators; <ls>Rājadharmakaustubha, G. O. S. 72, p. 102</ls>. .²5 A village two miles long; <ls>Bibliotheca Indica 274, Fasc. I. p. 145</ls>.
